name: Nx
description: Nx provides ecosystem-native enforcement mechanisms for architectural/module boundaries using project tags and dependency constraints.

rules.title: Express project dependency constraints declaratively
rules.summary: Nx can enforce which tagged projects are allowed to depend on which other tagged projects, including import checks in JavaScript/TypeScript linting.

sources.title: Enforce Module Boundaries | Nx
sources.notes: Official Nx documentation describes declarative architectural constraints and lint integration.
